The physrot2 batch is almost done and I made no changes this run: nothing is waiting, so there is nothing to schedule onto the idle cores and GPUs.

**Now**
- **Running:** 3 runs, all making progress (logs updated within the last 30 s). p027 is on CPU and has been running since 20:38; p147 and p149 are on GPU 1.
- **Finished in the last 60 min:** 20 runs.
- **Idle:** CPU use is 8 of 32 cores with no throttling, so CPU is no longer the limit. GPUs 3–6 are completely idle. Memory is 113.6 / 128 GiB, but only 21.8 GiB is real process memory; the rest is file cache.
- **Next hour:** once these 3 finish, everything will sit idle unless new work is queued. There has been no role round since r0003.
- **Health:** all services are up and no runs are hung. The two missing tmux sessions (biocage_physio_rot, biocage_physio_v3) are finished jobs, which is expected. The 3 running runs can resume from their checkpoints after a restart.
- **evo task queue:** empty.

**Needs a person**
1. **15 of 37 finished physrot2 runs ended in error.** All 15 ran on GPU and failed with "Fatal error in factorization of stiffness matrix"; none of the CPU runs failed. Whoever owns physio_rot_r2 needs to decide whether to re-run them on CPU or accept them as non-convergence. If re-run, the ~24 free cores would take about 6 at a time. I did not re-queue them because that is a science decision.
2. **physrot2_p001 is still failed:** its case directory is missing, and the real case appears to be in `physio_rot_r2_p001try`.
3. **Disk:** /raid has 190 GiB free (99% full), down 32 GiB in the last hour.

The report is in `work/agents/foreman/report_20261029_2250.md`; I also updated `status.json` (Traditional Chinese summary included) and added one line to `work/ops/foreman_actions.log`.
